about: Round PROG4 (Karl, 2 Nov 2026: gear from "Everywhere" - common pieces in town shops for gold; better ones in chests, from bosses and quests; the design is the Project doc claude/HANDOVER_PROGRESSION_2026-11-02.md section 3.4). EVERY name, word, price and number here is a placeholder (Claude's draft, 3 Nov 2026) for Karl to edit; prog-tune measures the numbers. slots: where a piece is worn, in the order the Gear screen lists them; a slot with "perk" opens only once that perk is taken (Pack Mule) and with "any": true holds a piece of any slot. pieces: name, slot, rarity (common: sold in town shops; uncommon / rare: found), region (the first region it belongs to), price (gold in a shop; a found piece's price is only shown), icon (assets/rpg/gear/<icon>.png, drawn by tools/rpg_gear_icons.py - Manticore's own work, CC0), text (what the piece says it does, one line) and effect. effect keys: life (+/- starting life in an Adventure duel), hand (+/- cards in the opening hand), battlefield (cards on your battlefield at the start: a real card in our Forge copy or token:SCRIPT, one of Forge's token scripts), command (real cards in your command zone at the start - the relics here are Wizards' Conspiracy cards, whose abilities work from the command zone), reward_choices (+N cards offered per reward pick), gold_mult (a won duel's gold times N), walk_speed (your walking speed on the map times N). sources: where the found pieces come from - bosses (foe kind -> piece, given when he is beaten), rares (rare foe id, rpg/data/rare_spawns.json -> piece, dropped the first time it is beaten) and quests (quest id -> piece, given with the quest's reward); a chest names its piece in progression.json (chests.list.<id>.gear). A piece is owned once: one found again is not given twice. rpg/gear.py reads and checks this file.
